home.title: Home

sections.heading: Creating space for the conversations that matter
sections.body:
The Conversation Project creates opportunities for people to connect more deeply with themselves and each other through conversation walks, events and workshops.
In a world that's more connected than ever, meaningful conversation can be surprisingly hard to find. We create simple opportunities for people to slow down, open up and discover what happens when we move beyond small talk.

sections.heading: A little space for big conversations

sections.quote: We are hardwired to connect with others; it's what gives purpose and meaning to our lives, and without it there is suffering

about.title: About

sections.heading: Hello!
sections.body:
I'm Eileen, founder of The Conversation Project. I have a background in social enterprise, the community sector and education.

Passionate about health, wellbeing, relationships and community, I founded The Conversation Project in 2022 in response to the lack of opportunities for connection caused by the Covid 19 pandemic.

At a time when social isolation continues to be recognised as a major public health challenge, I've been creating welcoming spaces where people can come together to re-connect, build meaningful relationships, and flourish through conversations that matter.

contact.title: Contact

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body:
We'd love to keep in touch with you! If you'd like to host a Conversation Project event yourself please get in touch! If you're curious about our events and would like to know when the next one will be held in Edinburgh, please add your email to our newsletter and we'll keep you posted.
For all enquiries, please use the form below to send us a message.

terms.title: Terms and conditions

sections.heading: Terms and conditions
sections.subheading: How this site works, and how we use your details if you get in touch or sign up.

sections.heading: Using this website
sections.body:
This website is provided by The Conversation Project to share our work and make it easy to get in touch. Please use it in good faith. Do not attempt to disrupt the site, misuse forms, or copy content without permission.

Event listings may link out to Eventbrite or other third-party pages. Those services have their own terms, and we are not responsible for their content or booking processes.

sections.heading: Newsletter and contact details
sections.body:
If you sign up to the newsletter, we use your first name, last name, and email address to send news and updates about upcoming workshops and related work. The consent checkbox is required: we will not add you unless you agree.

You can unsubscribe at any time using the link in our emails, or by contacting us. If you write to us through the contact form, we will use the details you send only to reply and to follow up on your enquiry.

We do not sell your personal details.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms as the site or our work changes. The latest version will always appear on this page. If you have questions, please contact us.
